threat_model.threat_source: Actors competing to rapidly develop AI systems (including AI developers), who under-invest in safety measures
threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Harmful outcome (no harmful intent explicitly stated): potential “race to the bottom” scenarios in which actors compete to rapidly develop AI systems and under-invest in safety measures, and AI developers cannot commit unilaterally to stringent safety standards
threat_model.capability: Compete to rapidly develop AI systems; under-invest in safety measures
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: Competitive pressure: it is challenging for AI developers to commit unilaterally to stringent safety standards because such commitments could put them at a competitive disadvantage
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: Safety measures and stringent safety standards (under-invested in and not committed to)
